tei:div.tei:p: 591) ༄༅/ grub dbang pad+ma nor bu'i bka' 'bum nga rtags can la/ rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i tshogs sgrub bya ba'i 'don 'grigs bde chen nyi ma stong 'bar la ldeb/ 'jam dpal gshin rje 'chi bdag zil gnon la ldeb/ rta mgrin khams gsum rol pa la ldeb/ yang dag sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la ldeb/ phur pa bdud dpung zil gnon la ldeb/ rol chen gtor bzlog gi 'don 'grigs bdud dpung zil gnon la ldeb/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i brgyud 'debs la ldeb/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor bzlog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi 'don 'grigs nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin la ldeb/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor bzlog 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ bka' brgyad gtor bzlog zin bris la ldeb/ nyang gter bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen 'don 'grigs bde chen dgyes pa'i lang tsho la ldeb/ bka' brgyad bde gsang 'brel ba'i sgo nas nyams pa skong ba'i cho ga lag tu len tshul gāṅga'i chu rgyun la ldeb/ 592)rtsa gsum srung mar bcas pa'i skong gso dus dang rgyun du gtong tshul rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung la ldeb/ bla ma dgongs 'dus bskang chog 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ bla ma dgongs 'dus bskang chog gtong tshul zin bris la ldeb/ rdor sems gnas stong gsog lugs dri med shel gyi mchod rten/ rdor sems gnas lung brgya stong gsog pa'i 'don 'grigs nor bu chu dwangs la ldeb/ rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong du sbyin sreg bya tshul ldeb/ rdor sems gnas brgya gsog tshul ldeb/ rdor sems zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi zin bris rig 'dzin rol pa'i dga' ston la ldeb/ zhi khro'i las 'grigs la ldeb/ zhi khro'i gnas brgya gsog lugs ldeb/ zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba 'don lugs ldeb/

dkon mchog spyi 'dus la mkhas grub karma chags med pa'i las bzhi sbyin sreg sbyor lugs ldeb/ gnam chos rten gsum rab gnas 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ bla ma dgongs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen 'don 'grigs byin brlabs sprin phung la ldeb/ bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub chen gyi gdangs dbyangs btang 593)lugs ldeb/ bla ma gsang 'dus kyi 'don 'grigs ldeb/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zin gnon gyi gtor bzlog lag len mi pham zhal lung la ldeb/ tshe bdag dkyil chog lag len la ldeb/ byang gter tshe bdag gtor ma'i bca' thabs la ldeb/ chos spyod tshul bzhin bya ba'i zin thun thar pa'i sa bon la ldeb/ yum ka'i rnam rgyal tshe sgrub 'don lugs la ldeb/ yum ka'i las tshogs g.yang sgrub tshig tho la ldeb/ yum ka'i gter bum sgrub pa'i lhan thabs kyi 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ yum ka'i sun bzlog btang tshul la ldeb/ bla bslu'i las 'grigs la ldeb/ yum ka'i seng gdong 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ gnam chos zhi khro bsam gtan cho ga gtong lugs ldeb/ bde ba can du bgrod pa'i cho ga dpag med myur lam gtong tshul la ldeb/ bde chen zhing sgrub kyi 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig gi sgrub chen dngos gzhi'i gtor ma'i zhal khrid la ldeb/ snying tig gsol ka'i gtor ma'i zhal khrid la 594)ldeb/ snying thig rtsa gsum gtor ma bca' thabs dang char 'bod 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ bskang gso rgyas pa gtong lugs la ldeb/ gur drag sbyin sreg 'don lugs la ldeb/ lcags 'dul 'don lugs la ldeb/ gri 'dul bcas bshams la ldeb/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi 'don 'grigs rgyud byang bltas chog la ldeb/ kun mkhyen lugs kyi sgyu 'phrul zhi khro gtong lugs la ldeb/ ya bzhi'i dbang sgrigs la ldeb/ tshe 'gugs dmigs gnad la ldeb/ klong chen snying thig rig 'dzin 'dus pa sogs kyi dpal yul lugs kyi rnga 'grigs la ldeb/

tshes bcu la rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs skong 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ rigs 'dus tshe sgrub tshogs brgya 'chi bslu bcas gtong tshul la ldeb/ o rgyan smin grol gling gi rol tshig spyi 'gro la ldeb/ thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gtong lugs la ldeb/ phur pa yang gsang sgrub pa'i smad las dang byang gter bdud 'dul sri mnan dbal mdos bcas sbrel tshul la ldeb/ rat+na'i phur pa'i gtor bzlog 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ 595)phur pa'i sri mnan 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ rat+na'i gur drag gtor bzlog 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ bzlog rol che ba'i rnga 'grigs ldeb/ cho ga gang rung la 'khrul pa sbubs bshig sbrel tshul la ldeb/ yum ka'i tshe chog bla bslu 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ nyang dang rat+na'i gter kha gnyis 'dus rta mgrin nag po'i gtor bzlog 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ brda go mgon khang gi dus mchod gtong lugs ldeb/ dus mchod gtong lugs ldeb/ phrin bcol ldeb/ smin gling rgyal brngan gtong lugs ldeb/ bsang brngan mchod pa'i sprin gyi khang bzang gtong tshul ldeb/ rdo rje ngang dkar bsang la ldeb/ kun mkhyen bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi lung bstan la sgro btags te legs phyogs nas smos pa'i gsol 'debs la ldeb/ tshar bcu gsog thabs ldeb/ dkar chag rang nyid la ldeb/ bcas bsdoms ldeb grangs/ bzhugs// ༈ rgyal kun spyi gzugs mtsho skyes rje'i// ring lugs 'dzin la zla bral ba// thub bstan chos kyi glang 596)po yi// phrin las sa gsum khyab gyur cig dge'o//
